# CaseTwin

CaseTwin converts a private CSV import failure into a deterministic fictional reproduction.
Read README.md for setup and limits and DESIGN.md for the C3 interface specification.

## Agent interface
- Run: node mcp/server.js --demo (fictional approved fixture)
- Real local export: CASETWIN_BUNDLE_PATH=/absolute/path/to/casetwin-share-bundle.json node mcp/server.js
- Transport: MCP stdio. No inference in the MCP server.
- prepare_repro: return the path of a locally exported approved bundle only.
- get_repro: return only the approved fictional CSV (UTF-8 or Base64).
- get_validation_report: return fingerprint and sanitized check results only.

Never request or expose customer CSVs, original filenames, original cell values, original row numbers, raw logs or local AI notes. The tools cannot approve a bundle or create a repro from customer data. Approval is a local user action in the web app. Files must come from a trusted local export directory. Do not send a bundle to other systems without user instruction.

## Inference boundary
The executable policy table is src/inference-policy.js. Private summaries use ONLY_ON_DEVICE. Drafts use ONLY_IN_CLOUD with fictional repro and static importer code. Rewrites use PREFER_ON_DEVICE with report text only. All inference uses firebase/ai from firebase 13.4.0. Demo cloud operations are simulations.
